x: Referee for the race was past President Ray Hall, whilst Chief Judge was Syd Spencer, also judging were Joe Coleman, Fred Denny, Barbara Dunsford, Harold King, Bill True and Joe Wilson, recording was Frank Webb and of course masterminding the final result in the back room was Jack Goswell ably assisted by Joan.
Another job performed by Jack, with the help of his wife Joan, was organising the annual Belgrave Open 7 Miles Road Walk each November at Wimbledon.

We would often hear of how late he, and Joan, worked to ensure that all ran smoothly. Race days saw him arrive early to organise our teams and, if it was a home fixture, sort out the officials and recording in readiness for the printing of the results and the prize giving.

In 1938 he married Joan, with son David being born in 1939, to be followed later by daughters Susan and Elizabeth. With the outbreak of the Second World War Stan soon found himself in the Army and as a member of the Service Corps, was one of those who helped drive the enemy out of the occupied island of Guernsey.
